preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 99 inclusive.
The length of the string s is a multiple of 3.

preconditions.expression: all(c in ascii_uppercase for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string s are uppercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the number of letters changed during transmission.
